components.css: :host{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque Variable",sans-serif;--paper:#f7f6f2;--surface:#fffefd;--ink:#242323;--muted:#615d5a;--rule:#d4cfcb;--accent:#b3342a;--button:#b3342a;--tint:#f3e9e5;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);color:var(--ink)}*{box-sizing:border-box}[hidden]{display:none!important}p,h3,ul{margin:0}p{line-height:1.7}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:5px}input, textarea { font: inherit; }input, textarea { outline-offset: 5px; }input, textarea { caret-color: var(--accent); }form label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; }input, textarea { min-width: 0; width: 100%; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 3px; padding: 14px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; }input { min-height: 52px; }textarea { min-height: 140px; resize: vertical; }input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: Original pen drawings, red-marker emphasis, cut-paper photographic mashups and a semantic comic exercise extend the red/charcoal personal teaching space. All artwork is digital editorial decoration, without pretending to be founder handwriting or real classroom artifacts.

rules.name: Content before margin art
rules.body: Draw around readable text, clear actions and the whole face/instrument.

rules.name: Digital decoration, honest evidence
rules.body: Use original SVG; never claim invented handwriting or events as real.

dos: Keep original Romanian facts, dates-forthcoming state and honest email behavior.
Reflow the collage for phones and remove peripheral marks as needed.
Keep the actual source photography and its provenance.
donts: Do not publish private personality descriptions.
Do not copy reference artwork or invent teacher feedback.
Do not add perpetual animation or heavy drawing libraries.
